shared_prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One clear real-world documentary photograph for a Spanish-speaking beginner's English review. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material grain and plausible lighting, realistic anatomy and hands. NOT an illustration, collage, cutout, split panel or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, internal padding, fake blur bands, watermarks, captions, speech bubbles, logos or readable words except an explicitly requested numeral. A first-time learner must recognize the meaning at phone size: the key person, action and object are large, sharp and inside the central safe area. Fresh scenes for this review only; never imitate a previous course photo. Ordinary anonymous people, never the recurring course cast (no Ana, Luis, Sofia or Diego).

assets.prompt: A woman in her thirties sitting at a plain table clearly enjoying a plate of cooked fish, photographed from across the table in daylight. She is smiling warmly at the fish while lifting a forkful of white fish towards her mouth, her free hand relaxed on the table. The whole fish fillet on the plate and her face are both sharp and together fill at least 45% of the frame width. Her expression is unmistakably pleasure, never doubt or refusal, and both hands stay open and natural. No pushing away, no raised palm, no other person, no other food, no readable words.

The plate of fish and his face and raised palm are all sharp and together fill at least 45% of the frame width. He is not eating and holds no fork to his mouth. No smiling at the food, no other person, no other food, no readable words.

assets.prompt: Use case: text-exact. A market price tag standing in front of one loaf of bread on a wooden stall counter, photographed straight on and close in daylight. The tag is a plain white card in a small metal holder and shows exactly the characters $2 in clean black handwriting, nothing else: no decimals, no cents, no words, no other numerals anywhere in the frame. The tag fills at least 30% of the frame width, is perfectly sharp and fully legible, and the loaf behind it is recognisable but secondary. No second price tag, no people, no hands, no logos.

assets.prompt: A café server handing one white cup of coffee across the counter to a customer, photographed from the side in warm daylight so both people are clearly visible and do not overlap. The server holds the saucer with both hands and offers it forward; the customer, a woman in her twenties, receives it with both hands and smiles in thanks. The cup is exactly in the middle between them and both faces are sharp; the two people and the cup together fill at least 60% of the frame width. Only one cup is being handed over. No money, no card, no tray of other drinks, no third person, no readable words, no logos.

change_control.reason: Lesson 5.8 teaches Yes, please as an accepted offer, and the old review could only show it by repeating a teaching card.

assets.prompt: A café customer clearly accepting an offer, photographed from the side in warm daylight. A server holds out a small plate with one pastry on it towards a man in his thirties seated at a café table; the man nods with a warm open smile, his palm turned upward towards the plate in a welcoming take-it gesture, and his other hand rests on the table. It reads unmistakably as yes, never as refusal: no raised stop palm, no head turned away, no frown. Both faces, the offered plate and the accepting hand are sharp and together fill at least 55% of the frame width. No third person, no readable words, no logos.
